title: ADR with empty-string semantic reference
context: An ADR whose only semantic reference is an empty string.
decision: Test that an empty-string semanticRefs item is rejected.
consequences: An empty reference is not resolvable.
invariants: Each semantic reference must be a non-empty string.
forbiddenDrift: Do not record an empty reference.
aiAlignmentRules: Stop if a reference is empty.
permittedChanges: A reference may be replaced with a non-empty value by a recorded decision.
description: Defect: semanticRefs contains an empty string, violating item minLength 1.
aiGuidance: This instance must be rejected because a semantic reference is empty.
